description: This file is a React component for the Explore Roles page of a job/career web application. It handles state management, data fetching from API endpoints, filtering, and rendering role cards and suggestions. The code integrates with various components like SearchBar, Filters, RoleCard, and manages dynamic UI behavior such as sticky headers and loading states.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL for API calls, prioritizing environment variables.

methods.name: joinUrl
methods.description: Concatenates base URL and path, ensuring proper slash placement.

methods.name: safeParseSalaryUsdRangeToLakhs
methods.description: Converts a salary range string from USD to INR lakhs, parsing various formats.

methods.name: mapSearchRowToUiRole
methods.description: Maps backend API role search result row to a UI Role object.

methods.name: mapRecommendationToUiRole
methods.description: Transforms recommended role data into a UI Role object.

methods.name: Page
methods.description: Main React component for the Explore Roles page, manages state, data fetching, and rendering.
